description: Ministry of Defence - United Nations Security Council Resolution (UN SCR) 1373. Regulation No. 1 of 2012
reasoning: This gazette content amends the list of designated persons, groups, and entities under the United Nations Regulations No. 1 of 2012, as authorized by THE UNITED NATIONS ACT, No. 45 OF 1968. It constitutes a legal/regulatory amendment to existing regulations, falling squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters, including amendments to statutory instruments.
